accepted.reason: pass -> fail. Does NOT fit GATE-A1's literal wording: the old pass matched Chrome (old ink bbox [8, 18, 282, 89] (7643 px, pages [1, 1]), Chrome ink bbox [8, 19, 283, 89] (7603 px, pages [1, 1])). It came from html_normalize rewriting the DOM (a left float followed by text inside div.box: the text was wrapped in an inserted <div>, turning the inline formatting context into a block container). Without the rewrite Blitz 0.3.0-beta.4 lays the float out inside the inline formatting context and ignores it for the line (floats-132: float at location (0, -4) under unwrapped text); the box walk reads that faithfully. Enabling blitz-dom's `floats` feature does NOT restore it (CONFIRMED, step-05 WPT experiment). New: ink bbox [8, 18, 282, 89] (7723 px, pages [1, 1]).

settings.x: pen origin x of the word's first glyph (pt, page top-left origin)
settings.y: baseline = origin y of the word's first glyph (pt, page top-left origin)
settings.text: NFC, U+FB00-U+FB06 ligatures expanded, case-sensitive; words split at whitespace and span boundaries
settings.pairing: same page, same text: maximum-cardinality minimum-total-distance assignment (Hungarian); Euclidean distance on (x, baseline); a pair farther than maxDistancePt is unpaired
settings.key: Chrome word: p<page>|<text>#<n>, n = rank among the same-text Chrome words of the page by (baseline, x)
